introH2: 🏖️ How many kinds of Mae Phim beachfront stays are there, and how do you pick the right one?
introHtml: Mae Phim is a golden-sand beach stretching about 4 kilometres in Klaeng district, Rayong, lined with pines and sea-almond trees for shade and quieter than the bigger tourist beaches — and the beachfront stays here come in more shapes than you'd think. Some are spacious apartments with a kitchen that you can walk down to the sand from in a few steps, good for anyone who wants to cook fresh seafood themselves. Some are beachfront resorts with a pool for the kids and easy reach of the pier across to Koh Samet. And some are bungalow resorts set in a big garden that sell quiet and privacy. A lot of people book a seaside stay and end up with something that doesn't match their trip — expecting a pool but getting an apartment, or wanting a new room but getting an older resort — and walk away feeling it wasn't worth it. This article gathers 5 Mae Phim beachfront stays in Rayong that we've already reviewed in depth, on both Mae Phim Beach and Laem Mae Phim — every one drawn from reading real guest reviews, with the upsides and the honest caveats, prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links for all of them.
mrtHtml: Mae Phim doesn't have convenient public transport like a big city — having your own car or renting one makes getting around easiest. From Bangkok it's a drive of about 200–220 kilometres via Motorway 7 onto Sukhumvit Road and the Klaeng bypass, taking roughly 2.5–4 hours depending on your destination. From Rayong city it's about 48 kilometres, or 50–60 minutes by car. The areas in this article: Mae Phim Beach — the main beach with seafood restaurants and full conveniences, a 7-Eleven and a row of seafood spots. Laem Mae Phim — known for beautiful sunsets and a quieter feel. Nearby sights: Suan Son, the Sunthorn Phu Monument, Thung Prong Thong, and the Ban Phe / Laem Tan piers that cross over to Koh Samet.

entries.name: AG Property Mae Phim
entries.badge: 🍳 Full kitchen · best value of the group
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Laem Mae Phim beach · a few steps down to the sand
entries.addr: Laem Mae Phim Beach, Kram subdistrict, Klaeng district, Rayong
entries.storyHtml: If there's one stay in this area that reviews rate highest for both location and value, a lot of people give it to this one — AG Property Mae Phim is an apartment-and-rental-house stay in the Laem Mae Phim beach area that leans into the idea of "like having a second home by the sea" more than being a hotel with staff watching your every move. Its Trip.com score sits at about 8.6, with the location category climbing to around 9.2 and value about 8.8, the highest in this article. What makes people pick it is a trio that's hard to find at an easy price — every unit has a kitchen with a fridge and stove, many rooms have a sea-view balcony, and it's a few steps down to the sand. Reviews tell the same story: in the evening you take the kids to run on the sand, watch the famous Laem Mae Phim sunset, then come back and buy fresh seafood from the beachside market to cook in your room — cheaper and more relaxed than eating out every meal. For families with small children, the stay has an indoor kids' play corner and baby gates — details a lot of parents look for but rarely find at this price. There's an on-site restaurant open for dinner and brunch, plus bike rental, car rental, and paid airport transfers to U-Tapao. The honest caveats from reviews: this is a simple beach-house stay with no pool, gym, or spa like a luxury resort, each unit varies in size and condition so check the details of the room you book carefully, and it's a small property that may not have a 24-hour front desk, so arrange your check-in time ahead, especially if you arrive late. This is the best value per baht in the group for families and anyone planning a long stay, cooking their own meals, and wanting a slow life on a beach quieter than the famous ones.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Check the room size, number of beds, and whether it's a sea-view unit against your group size before confirming. Arrange your check-in time with the stay ahead, since there may not be a front desk around the clock. And buy fresh seafood from the beachside market to cook in the kitchen for the best value.

entries.name: Arcadia Maephim
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.4 · 16 reviews · couples rate location about 8.6
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Mae Phim Beach · about 50 m to the sea

rooms.type: Family Suite (~48 sq m, some with kitchen)

tags: 🛏️ Biggest rooms up to 83 sq m
entries.addr: 236/22 Moo 3, Mae Phim Road 3145, Kram subdistrict, Klaeng district, Rayong
entries.storyHtml: If you're coming as a family or a group of friends and want a spacious room on the beach on a light budget, Arcadia Maephim is a name that comes up often on stay lists for this area. It's a 6-storey serviced apartment with a lift that nails the location and room size, with an overall Trip.com score of about 8.4 from 16 reviews and couples rating location as high as about 8.6. Its biggest draw is rooms in several sizes, from a Junior Studio of about 20 sq m up to an Executive Suite as big as 83 sq m that comfortably sleeps several people, and some room types have a kitchen with a microwave so you can buy fresh seafood and cook it yourself. The location is only about 50 metres from the sea, a few steps down to the sand, with a row of seafood restaurants across the road and a 7-Eleven right at the entrance. Reviews agree the rooms are clean, the beds comfortable, and they're more spacious than the price — especially the two-bedroom, two-bathroom rooms that people call great value for a group. The shared areas include a rooftop view deck where you can sit and catch the breeze over the Mae Phim sea in the evening, there's a lift that helps families with elderly members or lots of luggage, and the owner and staff get praise for being friendly and helpful. The honest caveats from reviews: there's no pool and no breakfast, which leaves some people who expect a resort feel getting less than they imagined, parking is limited when it's busy, and some of the decor and bathroom fittings look a touch dated. If you set the right expectation that this is a beachfront apartment selling room space and location, not a resort with a pool, it's great value in the budget-to-mid range.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you want a sea view, ask for a higher floor on the front side when you book, since the view from the upper floors of the 6-storey building shows the sea more clearly. To save money, pick a room listed as having a kitchen and buy fresh seafood from the spots across the road to cook yourself. Arrive before evening, as parking is limited.
pros: Spacious rooms in several sizes, up to 83 sq m — suites are great value for families
About 50 m to the sea, walkable to the sand; some rooms have a kitchen to cook in
Seafood spots across the road and a 7-Eleven at the entrance — very convenient
Friendly owner and staff, 24-hour counter (from reviews)
cons: No pool and no breakfast — not a full-service resort
Parking is limited when it's busy
Some decor and bathroom fittings look a touch dated (from reviews)

entries.name: Mae Pim Resort Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 On Mae Phim Beach · about 30 min to the Koh Samet pier
tags: 🏖️ On the beach, walk down to the sea
entries.addr: 234/2-19 Moo 3, Phe-Klaeng-Kram Road, Kram subdistrict, Klaeng district, Rayong
entries.storyHtml: Among the Mae Phim beachfront stays, if you measure by the number of reviews, Mae Pim Resort Hotel has the most in this article — about 338 reviews on Booking.com scoring 7.7, plus another 65 reviews on Trip.com scoring 8.6. It's a 3-star resort of about 120 rooms that's been open for many years, sitting directly on Mae Phim Beach, a few steps through the garden from your room to the sand — a location Bangkok folks like for a weekend break since it's about a 2.5-hour drive. What sets it apart from the apartments in the same area is that it's a full resort — there's an outdoor pool in a shady garden, ringed by trees and poolside chairs that the kids love all day, plus a gym, sauna, steam room, and a meeting room that takes up to about 200 people. The breakfast buffet is the thing most often praised about the food, with many reviews calling it varied and better quality than the price, covering both Thai and international dishes, served about 6–10am. On Booking.com the location category scores high at about 8.9, which reflects that the main strength is the on-the-beach spot and the atmosphere, and it's also only about 30 minutes from the Ban Phe pier that crosses to Koh Samet, a good base before catching the boat. The honest caveats from reviews: it's an older resort where some buildings and furniture show their age, some rooms have a musty smell and little storage space, the air-con in some rooms doesn't get fully cold, cleanliness is uneven at times, and the pool isn't very big relative to the size of the resort. If the goal is sleeping on the beach with a pool at a light price for a family, this does it well — which is why a lot of people come back to stay year after year.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The resort has been open a long time and room condition isn't even across all buildings, so ask for a recently renovated room when you book to avoid a musty one. Families are better off picking a Family room with an extra bed than booking several Superiors. If you're heading on to Koh Samet, allow about 30 minutes to drive to the Ban Phe pier.
pros: Most reviews in the article, about 338 on Booking.com · location about 8.9
On Mae Phim Beach, walk down to the sea from your room, with a pool in the garden
Varied breakfast buffet, better quality than the price (often praised in reviews)
About 30 min from the Koh Samet pier · free parking
cons: Buildings and rooms are getting old with the resort's age, some rooms are musty
Room cleanliness is uneven at times · air-con in some rooms isn't fully cold
The pool isn't very big relative to the resort's size (from reviews)

entries.name: Pimpimarn Beach Hotel
entries.badge: 👨‍👩‍👧 Family room for 8 · cheapest starting price
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Laem Mae Phim · across from the beach, just cross the road
tags: 🏖️ Cross the road to the sea
entries.addr: 236 Moo 3, Laem Mae Phim Beach, Kram subdistrict, Klaeng district, Rayong
entries.storyHtml: If you're coming as a group and want to push the per-head price as low as possible in this area, Pimpimarn Beach Hotel is a name that's been part of Laem Mae Phim beach for a long time and has the cheapest starting price in this article at about ฿900/night. It's a mid-sized loft-style beachfront hotel selling simplicity, an on-the-beach location, and an attainable price, with an overall Trip.com score of about 7.9 from 45 reviews. What makes people pick it is that it sits right on the beachside road, a few steps across the road and you're on the sand, with an open sea view from the front, a 7-Eleven near the entrance, and a row of Mae Phim's well-known seafood restaurants across the road. The highlight that makes it genuinely good value is the family room that sleeps up to 8 people per room — rare in a seaside hotel — and the per-head average clearly beats splitting into several rooms, while many of the upper-floor rooms have a sea-view balcony that reviews call worth paying a little extra for. There's an in-house Thai-seafood restaurant, free parking, a 24-hour counter, and it can take groups of up to about 200 people. The honest caveats from reviews: there's no pool (but the sea is just across the road), some rooms and furniture are getting old with the building's age, there are cleanliness issues in some rooms such as sand on the floor and a musty smell, on some nights you can hear noise from the road or events at the neighbouring hotel, and there are reports of double bookings in peak season, so confirm your booking with the hotel directly before you travel. For a simple beach trip where you want a beachfront location at the lightest price, this still does that job well.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you can afford it, pick an upper-floor sea-view room — the view is nicer and it's further from road noise. Check clearly whether the rate you book includes breakfast, since the info differs across platforms. And confirm the number and type of rooms with the hotel before you travel to avoid overbooking issues during long holidays.
pros: Cheapest starting price in the article, about ฿900/night, cross the road to the beach
Family room sleeps up to 8, per-head average is great value for a big group
Seafood spots across the road and a 7-Eleven out front, handy for every meal
The sea view from upper-floor rooms really is nice, friendly staff who speak English
cons: No pool · some rooms and furniture are getting old with age
On some nights you can hear road noise or events at the neighbouring hotel
Reports of double bookings in peak season, confirm before you travel (from reviews)

entries.name: Rockgarden Beach Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Laem Mae Phim · on Nam Daeng Beach (private beach)
entries.addr: 229 Moo 6, Kram subdistrict, Klaeng district, Rayong · Laem Mae Phim area
entries.storyHtml: We'll close with the stay we have to be the most straight about — Rockgarden Beach Resort is a garden bungalow resort on the sea where reviews split clearly into two camps. Some love the quiet and the value, while TripAdvisor gives it just 2.2 out of 5 from 11 reviews and ranks it near the bottom of the table for Rayong. What sets it apart from the others in the article is that it isn't a beachfront building but separate bungalows spread across a large, shady green garden of about 300 rai in the Laem Mae Phim area, on a quiet private beach, near Nam Daeng Beach at about 0.4 kilometres. The camp that likes it says you get an air-conditioned bungalow with Wi-Fi and hot water from about ฿1,500/night, which is more than worth the price, with a wide garden where kids can run and cycle all day, a pool with a slide and a separate kids' pool that families talk about most, plus a billiard room, table tennis, a barbecue area, and a fishing service. But to be honest, the camp that came away disappointed talks about damp and musty smells, peeling paintwork, old furniture, hard beds, uneven upkeep of the pool and garden, and an atmosphere so quiet some people feel like it's a deserted resort. The location is a trade-off too — there are no restaurants or convenience stores within walking distance of the resort, so you need your own car to drive out to Mae Phim Beach about 3.8 kilometres away for food, and the in-resort outlets keep limited hours. So we'd recommend checking the room condition at check-in, asking to change straight away if it's not okay, confirming your booking ahead, and always reading the latest reviews before booking. This suits budget travellers with a car who are after quiet, wide-open space, and a private beach at a cheap price — as long as you set the right expectations about upkeep and newness from the start.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: You need to bring your own car, since there are no restaurants or convenience stores within walking distance of the resort. Check the room condition at check-in, and if there's a musty smell or the condition isn't okay, ask to change straight away and take photos. Confirm your booking ahead and pick a free-cancellation rate to be safe.
pros: Wide, shady garden of about 300 rai on the sea — stroll and cycle all day
Pool with a slide and a kids' pool, the thing families talk about most
Quiet private beach, very private, near Nam Daeng Beach
Cheap starting price, an air-conditioned beachfront bungalow on a limited budget
cons: TripAdvisor 2.2/5 — caveats about upkeep of condition and cleanliness
No restaurants / convenience stores around the resort, you need your own car
In-resort outlets keep limited hours, few staff at times (from reviews)

faqTitle: FAQ — questions travellers ask most about Mae Phim beachfront stays in Rayong

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best Mae Phim beachfront stay?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style. If you want to cook your own meals and stay a while, AG Property Mae Phim scores 8.6, every unit has a full kitchen, with the highest location and value in the article. If you want a spacious, great-value room, Arcadia Maephim has suites as big as 83 sq m, about 50 metres to the sea. If you want a resort with a pool and lots of reviews, Mae Pim Resort Hotel. If you're coming as a group on a small budget, Pimpimarn has a family room for 8 from ฿900. And if you want a wide garden and a private beach, Rockgarden.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Mae Phim beachfront stays cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start at about ฿900–1,500 per night. The cheapest to start are Pimpimarn from ฿900 and Arcadia Maephim from ฿1,000. Mid-range are AG Property and Mae Pim Resort from ฿1,200, and Rockgarden from ฿1,500. Suites or houses for several people move up to about ฿2,500–3,000 by size and time of year. All prices are approximate starting prices from standard rooms, and during long holidays prices may be higher than usual.

faq.q: ❓ Which Mae Phim stay has a pool?
faq.a: In this article Mae Pim Resort Hotel has an outdoor pool in the garden, and Rockgarden Beach Resort has a pool with a slide and a kids' pool. Meanwhile AG Property, Arcadia Maephim, and Pimpimarn Beach Hotel have no pool, but all three are on or a few steps from the beach, so many people see the sea as a stand-in for a pool.

faq.q: ❓ Which Mae Phim stay has a kitchen to cook your own meals?
faq.a: AG Property Mae Phim stands out most for this, since every unit has a kitchen with a fridge and stove. Arcadia Maephim has a kitchen in some room types (especially the Family Suite and Executive Suite). The Mae Phim area has fresh seafood at local prices at the markets and beachside spots, so many people buy it to cook themselves to save money and have fun — good for a long stay with the family.

faq.q: ❓ Do you need your own car to go to Mae Phim Beach · how do you get there?
faq.a: We recommend having your own car or renting one, since the Mae Phim area has no convenient public transport. From Bangkok it's a drive of about 200–220 kilometres via Motorway 7 onto Sukhumvit into Klaeng, taking roughly 2.5–4 hours. From Rayong city it's about 48 kilometres. If you come by bus to Klaeng you have to take a songthaew or taxi to the beach. Rockgarden Beach Resort needs a car the most, since there are no shops within walking distance of the resort.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should you book a Mae Phim beachfront stay?
faq.a: Many Mae Phim beachfront stays have a small number of rooms and are popular with people from Bangkok and the eastern region, so they fill up fast. For long holidays, festivals (Songkran, New Year), and high season (November–February), book 2–4 weeks ahead or more. In normal periods a week or two ahead is enough. Every platform has free cancellation, so we recommend locking in that kind of rate first if your plans aren't set, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price. For Pimpimarn, confirm the number of rooms with the hotel directly, since there are reports of double bookings in peak season.
